candidates.formal_type: (G : Type u) → [inst : Group.{u} G] → Subalgebra.{0, u} Complex (MonoidAlgebra.{0, u} Complex G)

∀ {G : Type u} [inst : Group.{u} G] [inst_1 : Fintype.{u} G] (f g : Etingof.Remark4_5_3.ConvolutionAlgebra.{u} G)
  (z : G),
  Eq.{1} (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, 1} (MonoidAlgebra.coeff.{0, u} (HMul.hMul.{u, u, u} f g)) z)
    (Finset.sum.{u, 0} Finset.univ.{u} fun x =>
      HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, 1} (MonoidAlgebra.coeff.{0, u} f) x)
        (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, 1} (MonoidAlgebra.coeff.{0, u} g) (HMul.hMul.{u, u, u} (Inv.inv.{u} x) z)))
